⚠️ **A note on why this card is dispatched despite carrying no triage comment**, since this seat has today sent two comment-less `pm:queue` cards back as ungraded (#7650, #7661). Both discriminators clear it: it carries a **`priority:*`**, and its body has **no options table** — it names one remedy, states its own Clause-② and its own bump level. ⇒ it grades itself and the grading is consistent. ⛔ If triage disagrees, say so and this seat will pull it.

**Premise re-verified by this seat on `origin/main` = `a4611b3e2`** (the card measured at `6eebc54b6`):

| read | count |
| :-- | :--: |
| `ComboboxOption` in `packages/types/src/index.ts` | **0** |
| `SelectOption` (control) | **2** |

| `ComboboxSchema` (control) | **1** |

⇒ the instrument is lit and the zero is a reading. The `./form.js` re-export is an **explicit named list**, ⛔ not a wildcard that happens to miss it.

⚠️ **Both line numbers in the card have drifted:** the declaration is at `form.ts:1409` (card says `:1354`) and the named list closes at `index.ts:184` (card says `:179`). ⛔ Re-measure before the first edit.

**⭐ Blocker released and verified:** objectui#7683 merged as `51eb51558` (`feat(types,mobile)!: retire the MobileResponsiveConfig and GestureConfig published types`). The card's condition is met.

**⭐ One of the card's own notes is now stale, in its favour.** It warns that `content/docs/components/form/combobox.mdx` documents `ComboboxOption` as `{ value; label }` in a `plaintext` fence no gate reads, and is therefore stale against the types face. **That was fixed today** — objectui#7687 landed as PR #8142 (`c14d3a090`) and added the `disabled?: boolean` row; `disabled?: boolean` now reads **2** on that page. ⇒ ⛔ do not "fix" the docs again; ⭐ but do re-read them, because the census pin `component-docs-disabled-inherited-7239.test.ts` now claims that row and a further docs edit will move it.

**Boundaries:**
- ✅ Add `ComboboxOption` to the **existing named re-export list** from `./form.js`.
- ⛔ **Do not convert the list to a wildcard.** ⛔ **Do not move the declaration.**
- ✅ `minor` changeset stating the addition. It is **additive only** — nothing removed, retyped or narrowed, and the `@object-ui/types/form` subpath spelling keeps working. ⚠️ Pin both spellings, so a later "tidy" cannot silently drop the subpath.
- ⭐ The subpath was chosen **deliberately** in objectui#7691 (the root barrel was held by #7683 at the time) and the review judged it sound — the subpath is a house pattern (`@object-ui/types/zod`, `@object-ui/types/internal/retired-field-keys`). ⇒ this card is ⛔ **not** a defect in #7691; it is the follow-up #7691 could not take.
- ⚠️ Read-coupling: objectui#7687 is **closed** (PR #8142, landed today). ⛔ This card does not touch behaviour and does not revisit it.

Serial constraints cleared: `packages/types/**` is free — all three of this wave's `types` PRs have landed (#8145 `registry.ts`, #8154 `complex.*`, and #8153's read-only use). ⛔ No other slot names it. The queue arbitrates.

Landed as `f6375da3c` via PR #8177. Closing; `pm:dispatched` stripped and the assignee cleared in the same stroke.

**Verified by CONTENT** against a control proven before the merge — ⛔ never by sha:

| marker | pre-merge | post-merge |
| :-- | --: | --: |
| `ComboboxOption` in `packages/types/src/index.ts` | 0 | **1** |
| `export interface ComboboxOption` in `packages/types/src/form.ts` | 1 | **1** |

The second row is the leg that makes the first mean what it claims. A one-legged control could not distinguish "the name was re-exported from the barrel" from "the declaration was **moved** into the barrel" — and the latter is precisely the thing this card ruled out. The declaration staying put in `form.ts` is what proves the additive reading.

Lit control for the pre-merge zero: `SelectOption`, `RadioOption` and `ComboboxSchema` all read non-zero on the same file under the same query, so the zero was a reading rather than a dark instrument.

CI at the ready-flip: 32 check runs enumerated against `total_count: 32` — 28 success, 3 skipped, 1 failure, zero `in_progress`, with `Lint` read explicitly (green 22:35:47Z) and all four shards green. The single red was `Live E2E (informational)`, stood down on the structural argument rather than on marker-matching: its artifact upload reports **exactly 1 file** (the backend log), so no `playwright-report/` and no `test-results/` were produced — Playwright never ran, and a diff that never executed cannot be implicated.

⭐ Recorded because it is the best instrument work this seat has seen today: the dev caught **its own** regex defect before committing. The source scan's first pattern used a lazy body, matched two export clauses by running on to `index.ts`'s `import type { FormComponentSchema } from './form.js'`, and its own clause-count assertion caught it. That is the discipline — asserting on the shape of your instrument, not just its output.
